target: Add real mutation safety to the write layer: snapshot-and-restore so a partial batch_apply_patch failure can revert, not just resume. Today there is no backup/rollback anywhere in dopecode/.
invariants: Every event stream must have >=1 publisher and >=1 consumer.
Fail-closed on protection/identity; fail-open on advisory/telemetry.
Deploy runtime proof required; no build-then-strand.

pr.title: feat(dopecode): write-layer rollback/backup
pr.body: The write layer has boundary checks + SHA verify + resume, but no rollback. A partial batch leaves mutated files. Add snapshot/restore.

steps.task: Add snapshot-before-mutate + restore-on-partial-failure to the write/batch path.
validation: A forced partial batch failure restores all touched files to pre-mutation SHAs; unit-tested; preview mode unaffected.
